name: Strawberry Panzanella (Italian Bread Salad) with Chicken, Feta & Mint

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (454 g) pkgs strawberries
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince shallot. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup white wine vinegar
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter strawberries. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl and set aside. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Cut or tear bread into bite-sized pieces.

Return skillet (with drippings) to low heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bread and cook, stirring occasionally, until croutons are golden and toasted, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add croutons to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide panzanella salad between plates; top with chicken, feta, and reserved mint. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
